page.layout: One page of text, one column of verse with emblem titles in italic and roman; handwritten annotations in the margins and below the text (not printed, so not transcribed); no printed marginal notes.

main_text.l: Rex tamen es,regum cui se non conferat vllus:
main_text.head: Foeda peccati cicatrix. Deut.14.
main_text.p: Turpe fuit quondam vultus incidere ferro
Turpius at quanto plagas infligere menti,
Est tamen haec illi non raro iuncta; comesque
main_text.l: Fit plerumque grauis gratus odoris odor.
main_text.p: Sic cum laudatis rebus, plerumque remixtus

head.i: Planta singula virtutes habent suas. Sed rara

main_text.p: Quas profert tellus, multis e millibus, herba
main_text.l: Cui non sit virtus indita, nulla datur.
main_text.p: Viuentum, multis hominum de millibus, vnus
main_text.l: Vix est, cui virtus conferat vna decus.
main_text.p: Est eadem cunctas inter iustissima stirpes:
main_text.l: Hac mos est torta plectere namque reos.

page.notes: Handwritten Greek and a marginal word "Eryn-" in ink at the foot and left margin are manuscript annotations, not printed; omitted. Some Greek marginal annotation at the top left is handwritten. Scan has show-through from the reverse page.
